t: Kesheechad mibbene chatzer niprad mishsham o met
s: Kesheechad mibbene chatzer niprad mishsham o met ubo v' seipim: dira belo bealim enah dira veenah oseret bechatzer, vegam muttar letaltel mimmenna lechatzer sheyyesh bah diyyurim acherim sheerebu benehem, veeno kemotzi mereshut lirshut. Lepikak echad mibbene chatzer shehinniach beto vehalak im kol bene beto veshabat bechatzer acheret, apillu hayeta semuka lachatzero — im hissiach libbo veen dato lachazor lebeto beshabbat, hare zeh eno oser al bene hechatzer shebbeto shamma im erebu benehem, ap al pi shehu lo ereb immahem. Umuttarim letaltel gam mibbeto lechatzer. Vaapillu im achar kak nimlak vechazar lebeto beshabbat, eno oser, shekkevan shekkebar hissiach millibbo biknisat hashshabbat, hare shabbat zo — kevan shehuttera huttera, veshub lo teaser, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehalak mibbeto mibbeod yom. Abal im halak mishshechasheka — oser keshechozer. Venokri shehalak mibbeto yitbaer besimman shp"g:

Echad min hashshuq shehaya lo bayit bechatzer shello haya dar bah velaken lo ereb bah, umet vehinniach reshuto leechad mibbene otah chatzer — im met mibbeod yom, en hazzokeh oser, lepi shehaerub sheereb al bayit shello mattir gam bayit sheyyarash mibbeod yom, sheap shehaerub naasa qodem hayrushsha, mikkol maqom hare qeniyyat haerub hu biknisat hashshabbat, veaz yerasho kebar. Abal im met mishshechasheka — oser hazzokeh bo al bene hechatzer, vegam hu asur letaltel bechatzer, ben mibbayit shello ben mibbayit zeh, veap al pi sheereb immahem, eno moil lezeh sheyyarash beshabbat achar qeniyyat haerub. Vaapillu im zeh hazzokeh lo niknas adayin bebayit zeh ladur bo, en zo dira belo bealim, shekkevan shehu dar bechatzer zo verauy lehishtammesh bebayit zeh sheyyerasho — anu choshebin oto keillu niknas ladur bo. Veap al pi shebbiknisat hashshabbat keshehaya morisho chay velo haya dar bo hayeta dira belo bealim, velo hayeta oseret al bene hechatzer — en omerim bezeh "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", lepi sheen omerim ken ella keshebbeshaa shehuttera haya haddabar barur shello tachazor veteaser, kegon mi shehalak mibbeto mibbeod yom vehissiach millibbo shello lachazor ad motzae shabbat, shebbeshaa shehissiach millibbo haddabar yadua bevadday shello yachazor vehuttera az lekol hashshabbat, velaken enah chozeret veneeseret keshennimlak achar kak vechazar. Abal kan en haddabar yadua bevadday biknisat hashshabbat shello yabo baal habbayit zeh lebeto beshabbat, veen omerim shekkevan shello ba biknisat shabbat, hissiach millibbo ubevadday lo yabo kol hashshabbat:

Echad mibbene hechatzer shemmet beshabbat velo hinniach bene bayit bebeto, im ereb, apillu yerasho echad mibbene hashshuq veniknas ladur bo beshabbat — eno oser, ap al pi shehu lo ereb bechatzer zo, lepi sheshshabbat kevan shehuttera beerub hammorish — huttera, ubilbad shello haya hammorish goses mibbeod yom, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim hammorish lo ereb, virasho echad min hashshuq, kol zeman sheeno ba ladur bo — eno oser. Ba ladur bo beshabbat — oser. Shello shayyak kan "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera" (kevan shello huttera bitchillatah, veod) mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Veim yerasho echad mibbene hechatzer — oser ap al pi shello niknas adayin ladur bo, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu im ereb im bene hechatzer bishbil bayit shello, en erub zeh moil lebayit zeh sheyyerasho beshabbat achar qeniyyat haerub. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehayyoresh dar bebayit acher bechatzer zo. Abal im haya dar bebayit zeh im hammorish, venatan laerub mishshello bishbil bayit zeh shel hammorish — hare zeh moil, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a, shebbene beto shel adam yekolim leareb mishshellahen bead beto. Veim mibbeod yom met hammorish, virasho echad min hashshuq sheeno meareb im bene hechatzer — hare zeh oser im niknas ladur bo beshabbat, apillu im hammorish ereb kebar bechayyayv, lepi shekkevan shemmet — batel erubo:

Yisrael veger shehayu darim bechatzer veerebu yachad, umet hagger mibbeod yom, vehecheziq yisrael acher binkasayv, apillu lo hecheziq ad shechasheka — oser ad sheyyebattel reshuto kishar yoresh sheyyukal lebattel, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"a. Veap al pi shebbiknisat hashshabbat, kol zeman shello niknas yisrael zeh bebeto shel ger, hayeta dira belo bealim velo hayeta oseret — en omerim bah "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", hoil vehayeta reuya lehachaziq bah mibbeod yom, vehayeta teluya veomedet, velo haya az hetterah barur shettehe mutteret kol hashshabbat. Abal im mishshechasheka met hagger — en hammachaziq oser, shekkevan shebbiknisat hashshabbat haya muttar mechamat erubo shel ger, anu omerim "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera". Ubilbad shello haya goses mibbeod yom, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Echad mibbene hechatzer shehu goses, ap al pi sheeno yakol lichyot bo bayyom — oser ad sheyyezakku lo bepat viarebu alayv. Veim met beshabbat — en omerim bo "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", kevan sheen haerub rauy lehitqayyem kol hashshabbat, sherob gosesin lemita. Ulepikak im yerasho echad mibbene hechatzer shello ereb immahem, oser apillu im lo niknas adayin ladur bo, o im yerasho echad min hashshuq veniknas ladur bo:
Veken qatan oser, ap al pi sheeno yakol leekol kezayit. Abal oreach eno oser, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a:
